fixture_disclosure: Disposable native campaigns grant research/buildings, fund legacy positions and apply cash shocks. The QA bond decision only requests the production holder-consent dialog. All reported recoveries and accept/decline actions use normal production controls.

screenshots.note: Independent Overseas Bardi: native Credit exposes Begin resolution and creditor controls; cash 100, deposit claim 100 and equity 0. Guarantee controls are unavailable to the independent bank.
Normal independent Overseas-bank Begin resolution changes Bardi to In resolution, keeps cash and deposit liabilities at 100, disables repeated entry and enables recovery and consented terms.
Normal independent-bank Pay recovery pays the 100-gold deposit: cash/assets/liabilities and selected claim are now zero; state remains In resolution and further terms are disabled.
Final clean cold load: normal Decisions opens the Peruzzi original-issuer estate for its legal trustee Florence. Separate cash 40, deposits owed 100, recoveries zero; sovereign treasury 4800.

Final clean scene: production recovery debits estate cash 40 to zero, reduces deposit claim 100 to 60 and records 40 actual recoveries. Florence treasury rises 4800 to 4840; exhausted liquidation becomes available.

Final clean scene: normal exhausted liquidation closes Peruzzi (state 5), extinguishes the 60 unpaid deposit after statutory loss accounting, retains cumulative recoveries 40, and leaves treasury at 4840. Finalization cannot be selected again.

Final clean current-holder consent: Genoa offers Florence 20% principal/coupon reduction, annual coupon cut with 1% floor, optional two-year trade concession and funded revenue pledge. All text and three choices fit the native modal.

Final clean scene: normal secured acceptance creates the native Workout Trade Concession Granted confirmation with fully localized title/description and market-protection effects. Separate funded revenue pledge is stated explicitly.

Clean controller scene: normal Begin resolution changes Merchant Bardi to In resolution, keeps bank cash/liabilities at 100 and the selected deposit claim at 100, disables repeated entry and enables recovery.

Clean controller scene: normal Pay recovery moves 100 actual bank gold to Florence (4840 to 4940); bank cash/assets/liabilities and selected deposit claim become zero, cumulative deposit recoveries 100.

Generated shipping runtime: the live compact Sovereign Bonds claim row exposes Offer restructuring below the current face 100, annual coupon 3%, Genoese holder and unpaid coupons 5. The complete new action fits inside its card.
